Not any thing; no thing.

The ordinal form of the number eighteen.

A telecommunication device which converts data or sounds (usually speech) into electrical signals which are then transmitted to enable two or more people to communicate with each other over a distance; now usually a device having a dial or keypad with numerals for entering a number, etc., to connect with a person, and means (such as a sound or vibration) for alerting one to an incoming call or transmission; also, the handset or receiver of such a device.
Of, pertaining to, or transmitted by telephony.

A mathematical function that describes the propagation of the quantum mechanical wave associated with a particle (or system of particles), related to the probability of finding the particle in a particular region of space.
A small cigar consisting of tobacco or another substance, wrapped up in a thin roll with paper, intended for smoking.
A cylinder of tobacco rolled and wrapped with an outer covering of tobacco leaves, intended to be smoked.
A thin cigar, differing from a cigarette in being wrapped with tobacco leaves rather than paper.
A metal printing plate cast from a matrix moulded from a raised printing surface.
Female ejaculatory discharge.
